Status: all tests and the type check pass, and my extra edge-case probes behaved correctly. I'm wrapping up the review now.

**Verdict: mergeable. I found nothing the contributor must fix.**

**Checks**
- `pnpm test`: all 80 tests pass across the three test files (Tabs 23, Dialog 29, Combobox 28).
- `pnpm typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`): no errors. The test files are included because `tsconfig.json` includes `src`.
- The repo has no lint or format config, so there is nothing else to run.

**Extra probes.** I ran a temporary test file at `src/__probe.test.tsx`, then deleted it. `git status --short` is the same as when I started. What I checked:
- **Escape on Dialog** calls `onOpenChange` once (`escape calls [ [ false ] ]`). The React handler and the document-level handler don't both fire.
- **Under `StrictMode`, with Tabs and a Combobox inside a Dialog:**
  - Opening focuses the selected tab.
  - ArrowRight selects "Two" and shows its panel.
  - Tab moves to the combobox; typing `ban`, ArrowDown, Enter selects "Banana".
  - Escape then closes the dialog and focus goes back to the "open" button.
- **Combobox in a controlled parent under `StrictMode`:**
  - It starts showing "Apple".
  - ArrowDown, ArrowDown, Enter selects `b` and shows "Banana".
  - Clearing and typing `APP` filters case-insensitively to `['Apple']`, and selecting it sets `a`.

**Code review against the issue**
- **Tabs:** arrow keys wrap and skip disabled tabs, Home and End work, selection follows focus, only the selected tab is in the tab order, and it works controlled or uncontrolled. Disabled or missing values fall back to the first enabled tab. Ids are escaped into a single token.
- **Dialog:** it renders in a portal and is labelled and described by its title and description. It moves focus in on open, traps Tab, handles Escape and backdrop clicks, returns focus on close, and handles nested dialogs correctly.
- **Combobox:** it uses `aria-activedescendant`, skips disabled options, selects on Enter or click, closes on Escape without selecting, shows "No results", and uses `null` for no value.
- **README:** what it says about props and keys matches the code.

**Nits (none block the merge)**
- There's an empty `tests/` directory in the working tree. Its timestamp is later than the rest of the change, so it looks left over. Git doesn't track empty directories, so it has no effect.
- From reading the code (I didn't run it): a press that starts on the backdrop and is released inside the dialog would probably still close it. The browser sends the click to the backdrop, and the handler only checks the click target and where the press started.
- The "No results" `role="status"` element is only added when there are no matches. Screen readers announce a status region more reliably when it is always present and only its text changes.
- The trap's tabbable selector misses `summary`, `audio[controls]` and `video[controls]`. Also, an `id` passed to `Combobox` is silently replaced by the generated one.
- The README says "dependency-free beyond React 19", but `react-dom` is also a required peer dependency.
